messages.subject: Compilation errors w/ packages.
parts: I tried installing RRO on Mac (Mavericks). Seems like packages were being compiled from source, and had trouble compiling. Sorry, no spec examples because I got rid of it immediately, before I knew of the existence of this mailing list. Anyone else run into this and have a quick solution? Specifically had trouble with bioc packages that relied on kernsmooth, lme4, etc.

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: Compilation errors w/ packages.
parts:
Hi Stephen,

When did you try RRO? The previous 8.0.0 version was compiling packages from source, but the new 8.0.1 released today does install from binaries.

Cheers,
# David Smith
